vedic_philosophy.title: Vedic Philosophy | Sanatana Dharma
vedic_philosophy.description: Explore Vedic Philosophy through Dharma, Karma, Moksha, Samsara, Purushartha, Advaita, Bhakti, and Yoga.
vedic_philosophy.introduction: The Vedic philosophical tradition offers a multi-layered understanding of life, ethics, consciousness, and liberation.
vedic_philosophy.philosophical_explanation: Philosophical study in Sanatana Dharma is both contemplative and practical, linking metaphysical principles with lived dharma.

scripture_text.content: Core themes include duty, action, rebirth, liberation, non-duality, devotion, and disciplined spiritual practice.
